title: PhyloPower: manuscript-aligned power and sample-size estimation for meta-omics beta-diversity studies
description: PhyloPower provides manuscript-aligned raw-pool workflows for minimum sample-size estimation in metagenomic and metaproteomic beta-diversity studies. It combines PCAM with Gemelli for taxonomic feature tables and MDC-TF-MC with PhyloFunc for Taxon-Function data. This release includes readable modular source code and a self-contained single-file runner.
